text: Owner: "i want to switch to 5 day free trial, not a free plan, i cant afford that". The Free plan is removed. New orgs get a 5-day trial of Pro with a card required at signup (Stripe trial; bills automatically on day 6 unless canceled); trial compute is capped by a spending limit. A trial that ends without payment pauses the org (sites stop serving, containers and databases sleep, builds stop) and keeps its data 7 days, then deletes it. Every org on Free when this ships gets a fresh 5-day trial from then, with notice, then the same pause rule. Everything else from r-zdescb7y05vp1bxx stands: Pro $20/mo and Team $49/mo with their allowances, extra sites $2, SSR $7, over-allowance usage billed monthly, monthly only. Answers chosen by the owner on 2026-09-26: card up front; pause and keep data 7 days; trial plan Pro; existing Free orgs get a 5-day trial from ship.
